steps.title: Analyze Existing Architecture
steps.description: Understand application structure and evaluate native integration of built-in rendering engines.

steps.title: Design PDF Viewer User Interface
steps.description: Create activity_pdf_viewer.xml layout with preview canvas, scroll container, and custom toolbar header.

steps.title: Configure Page Control Elements
steps.description: Establish navigation bars, previous/next control buttons, and dynamic text indicators inside the layout.

steps.title: Integrate Native PdfRenderer Engine
steps.description: Create PdfViewerActivity.java incorporating Android SDK native PdfRenderer to parse file streams.

steps.title: Implement High-Resolution Page Canvas Rendering
steps.description: Add scaling logic to rasterize vector pages to crisp bitmaps before drawing to the layout container.

steps.title: Establish View Lifecycle Controls
steps.description: Safely manage descriptors, close open resources during state transitions to prevent native heap memory leaks.

steps.title: Bind Open Controls inside MainActivity
steps.description: Re-map the PDF archive row click listener to directly transition into our new inbuilt viewer screen.

steps.title: Declare Inbuilt Screen in Manifest
steps.description: Insert the PdfViewerActivity declaration inside the XML manifest configured under light non-actionbar themes.

steps.title: Validate Assembly Dependencies
steps.description: Audit build.gradle configurations to ensure Java target compliance is intact without third party libs.

steps.title: Perform Structural Meta Evaluation
steps.description: Verify app package definition consistency across build system properties and descriptor assets.

steps.title: Building PDF Creator Pro
steps.description: Compile standard debug deliverables to merge layout files, compile class files, and compile final APK.
